title: Make.com build with error handling, fallbacks and retries on every scenario
summary: A sample of how one fixed-fee Make.com build could be delivered: a scenario flow with an error route on every step, a retry and fallback table, and a short handoff form for each new build.

scenes.heading: Sample scenario: new order to CRM and Slack
scenes.caption: One example Make.com scenario where every step has its own failure path, using sample apps and data.

steps.label: Webhook: new order received
steps.detail: Custom webhook receives Order #1042 from Acme Store and checks that required fields are present.
steps.on_error: Missing fields: route to a Slack alert and store the payload in a data store for review.

steps.label: Lookup customer in CRM
steps.detail: Search by jane@example.com. Create the contact if none is found.
steps.on_error: API timeout: retry 3 times with growing delay, then use the fallback queue.

steps.label: Create deal
steps.detail: Create a deal linked to the contact with the order total and line items.
steps.on_error: Duplicate deal found: update the existing deal instead of creating a new one.

steps.label: Send confirmation email
steps.detail: Send the order confirmation to the customer.
steps.on_error: Email service down: switch to the backup sender module and log the switch.

steps.label: Post summary to Slack
steps.detail: Post a one-line summary to the ops channel.
steps.on_error: Slack fails: write to the run log only. Do not block the order.

steps.label: Log run result
steps.detail: Write status, duration and any retries to a log sheet.
steps.on_error: Log write fails: scenario still completes and the error handler emails the owner.

scenes.heading: Error, retry and fallback plan for each build
scenes.caption: The kind of plan delivered with each build so every failure type has a defined response.

scenes.heading: Build handoff sheet
scenes.caption: A short sheet filled in per build so scope, error rules and testing are agreed before work starts.

fields.label: Build name
fields.sample: Order to CRM and Slack sync

fields.label: Apps involved
fields.sample: Acme Store, Example CRM, Slack, Gmail

fields.label: Fallback behaviour
fields.sample: Park failed items in a data store and alert the ops channel

fields.label: Test cases to pass
fields.sample: Missing field, duplicate order, CRM timeout, expired connection

scenes.result: Build sheet saved. The scope, error rules and test cases are listed for sign-off before the scenario is built.

assumptions: The apps (store, CRM, Slack, email) are placeholders because the post names no tools.
The post gives no first build, so the order sync is only an example.
Assumed builds are delivered as Make.com scenarios in the poster's own Make account.
Assumed alerts go to Slack or email, which the post does not specify.
The company name is not given, so the demo is prepared for the post.
